patterns.name: Empty State
patterns.description: Centered illustration/message shown when a list or view has no content yet.
compositionRules: Message + optional primary Button action, centered vertically and horizontally.
layoutRules: Use spacing-16 between message and action button.
patterns.responsiveBehavior: Stacks vertically at all breakpoints; no layout change needed below 480px.
usageConstraints: Do not use for loading states — use a skeleton/spinner pattern instead (not yet registered).

patterns.name: Confirmation Dialog
patterns.description: A Modal used to confirm a destructive or significant action.
compositionRules: Modal with title, one sentence of body copy, and two Buttons: secondary Cancel + primary Confirm.
layoutRules: Buttons right-aligned in the footer, Cancel before Confirm.
usageConstraints: Confirm button appearance should be 'primary' unless the action is destructive, in which case use project rule 'destructive-action-color'.
